title: Verify tier-2 freshness enforcement on sutra_read
description: Check that sutra_read withholds content (not just flags is_stale) when the index is stale. Per freshness-envelopes.md, read is tier 2: refuse + withhold so the LLM can't anchor on outdated code.

acceptance_criteria.text: Tier-2 stale refusal logic moved from MCP adapter into tools::read::handle()
read::handle takes an is_stale parameter and withholds content when true
MCP layer computes staleness and passes it down (no longer does post-hoc content removal)
Contract test: when is_stale=true, response has 'refused' field and no 'content' field
Contract test: when is_stale=false, response has 'content' field and no 'refused' field
